hooks.text: 城内工匠经济自动采集与建造，再把村民产出转化为守军
hooks.excerpt: Instead, count on the help of your thriving artisan economy right within your castle walls and surrounding fields to make resource collection an absolute breeze. With a flourishing economy, automate the process of creating increasingly impressive structures. Then use the fruits of your villager’s labor to train a fearless band of defenders.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 亲自施放改造地形的魔法，并用攻城武器对抗持续进化的敌军
hooks.excerpt: Jump into the fray and wield unique magical abilities with the power to terraform the landscape. Alongside your insanely chaotic siege weaponry, you can turn the tide of battle and prove your mettle. This becomes incredibly important as you must defend your castle against ever-evolving enemy units that come equipped with wilder and more challenging abilities and traits over time.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 全可破坏物理把方块、风和火花变成武器，可串联跳板、尖刺、风道与磁铁
hooks.excerpt: Also did we mention that the entire environment is destructible? Everything can be altered by damage and magic. Why swing a sword when gravity will do it for you? Castle Craft's physics turn every block, gust, and spark into a weapon waiting to be rigged. Drop voxels from above to crush whatever's below. Channel wind tunnels to turn loose debris into deadly projectiles. Chain a jumping pad into a row of spikes, then into another wind tunnel that hurls the survivors off the map entirely. Line the approach with magnets to yank unsuspecting invaders straight into your nastiest surprise.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
